_comment: Pokemon playstyle / mechanic notes keyed by canonicalized species name (lowercase, alphanumerics only). Surfaced in the Team Builder to flag non-obvious mechanics a pilot must understand. Add freely — this is editable data, no code change needed.

palafin.title: Zero → Hero form change
palafin.text: Palafin starts in Zero Form (weak). It only changes to Hero Form after it SWITCHES OUT and back in at least once during the battle (ability: Zero to Hero). Plan to lead it, switch it out, then bring it back as a huge physical attacker. Jet Punch (priority Water) is its signature. It does NOT transform by staying in — you must pivot it once.

incineroar.title: Intimidate pivot
incineroar.text: Drops opposing Attack on entry (Intimidate). Core support: Fake Out, Parting Shot to pivot, Knock Off for item removal. Bringing it in repeatedly stacks Intimidate pressure.

torkoal.title: Sun setter for Trick Room
torkoal.text: Drought sets Sun on entry. Very slow — pairs with Trick Room. Eruption at full HP + Sun is a huge spread nuke; damage drops sharply as its HP falls.

rillaboom.title: Grassy Terrain + priority
rillaboom.text: Grassy Surge sets Grassy Terrain on entry (heals grounded allies, boosts Grass moves, softens Earthquake). Grassy Glide becomes priority in terrain — key for revenge KOs and speed control.

amoonguss.title: Redirection + Spore
amoonguss.text: Rage Powder redirects single-target attacks to itself (protects a partner). Spore is 100% accuracy sleep. Regenerator heals on switch. Classic bulky support.

flutter-mane.title: Fast special attacker (Paradox)
flutter-mane.text: Extremely fast and hits hard specially. Protosynthesis boosts its highest stat in Sun (or with Booster Energy). Fragile — relies on speed and Protect.

urshifu.title: Wall-breaking priority / bypasses Protect
urshifu.text: Single Strike (Wicked Blow) and Rapid Strike (Surging Strikes) both bypass Protect and always crit. Rapid Strike gets priority in some contexts via Aqua Jet. Huge physical pressure; watch which style you're facing.

dondozo.title: Commander with Tatsugiri
dondozo.text: With a Tatsugiri partner on the field, Dondozo gets massive stat boosts (Commander — Tatsugiri jumps into its mouth). The pair must be brought together to activate it.

tatsugiri.title: Commander enabler for Dondozo
tatsugiri.text: Triggers Dondozo's Commander when both are active, sharply boosting Dondozo. On its own it's a frail special attacker. Bring it specifically to enable Dondozo.
